Mirle Automation.why: Automated material-handling supplier whose semiconductor systems (OHT, stockers, wafer / ABF substrate / FOPLP EFEMs) serve packaging/test and substrate plants; it says CoWoS, CoPoS, CoWoP and FOPLP capacity expansion drives demand and expects semiconductor systems to exceed 60% of 2026 revenue.
Mirle Automation.evidence: Mirle Automation 2025 investor conference deck: its OHT, Stocker, 300mm wafer / ABF substrate / FOPLP EFEM and panel handling solutions fully support the multi-size carriers and process needs of CoWoS, CoPoS and CoWoP advanced packaging; won a FOPLP whole-fab automation project.

players.product: Semiconductor AMHS for advanced packaging and substrate fabs: OHT overhead hoist transport, stockers and 300mm wafer / ABF substrate / FOPLP EFEMs and panel handling (CoWoS, CoPoS, FOPLP)

quarterly_data.quarter: Mirle Automation IR presentation: 2025 Investor Conference (12-22-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2025 net revenue NT$1,627,461 thousand (-25.5% YoY), gross margin 18.7%, operating loss NT$39,620 thousand, net income NT$1,628 thousand. 2025 Q1-Q3 consolidated revenue NT$4,992 million with gross margin 19.1% (2024 full year: NT$7,503 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Mirle Automation IR presentation: 2025 Investor Conference (12-22-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (company): AI compute demand is driving fast capacity expansion of CoWoS, CoPoS, CoWoP and FOPLP advanced packaging and of demand for clean, flexible automated handling; Mirle's OHT, stockers, 300mm wafer / ABF substrate / FOPLP EFEMs and panel handling support these processes, and its new shared-rail OHT handles 12-40kg carriers. It has won a FOPLP whole-fab automation project expected to drive growth from Q1 2026, and expects semiconductor equipment systems to exceed 60% of 2026 consolidated revenue

quarterly_data.quarter: Mirle Automation IR presentation: 2025 Investor Conference (12-22-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Business mix: semiconductor automation systems became the main revenue line in 2024 and the company calls itself a main automation supplier to packaging/test and substrate plants; 2025 revenue came mainly from packaging/test, substrate and front-end wafer-fab logistics systems, and it has won front-end process customer orders. 2025 book-to-bill ratio above 1

quarterly_data.quarter: Mirle Automation IR presentation: 2025 Investor Conference (12-22-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 key-equipment capacity targets: OHT 100 units/month, EFEM 300 units/year, semiconductor stocker 300 units/year, AMR/AGV 200 units/year; overall capacity up 30%~40% in 2026 and expected to grow 3~5 times within 3~5 years

quarterly_data.quarter: Mirle Automation IR presentation: 2025 Investor Conference (12-22-2025)
